sources.claim: Sharp Chula Vista Medical Center is the South Bay's largest provider of women's and infants' health care
sources.quote: Take a virtual tour of Sharp Mary Birch Chula Vista, the South Bay's largest provider of health care for women and infants.

sources.claim: Sharp Chula Vista L&D rooms are private with bathroom and shower
sources.quote: After triage, you will labor and deliver your baby in one of our spacious suites that were made with your comfort in mind. All labor and delivery rooms are private with a dedicated bathroom and shower

sources.claim: Scripps Mercy Chula Vista closed its maternity ward in 2024
sources.quote: Shutting down maternity services at Scripps Mercy Hospital Chula Vista has not stopped pregnant women from showing up in its emergency department in need of obstetric services.
